messages:
nina: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling the base-image rebase next Tue. Need to lock down the signing + RBAC for the automated rebase pipeline before then. :hourglass:
omar: +1. Which KMS workflow are we using for signing? symmetric vs asymmetric matters for attestation.
tia: We prefer asymmetric signing keys in KMS so we can publish public keys for verification. Also reduces key export risk.
grant: Audit / retention question: cloud audit logs for the key usage need to be routed to the long-term bucket for compliance. Who owns that? :mag:
nina: Grant, can you own the logging path? We need 7 years retention per policy. I'll document the ACLs.
grant: I can — will create bucket and retention lifecycle. Need the exact log stream name from infra.
omar: infra: we plan to use kms:asymmetricSign on the service account used by the rebuild runner. Minimal perms: roles/cloudkms.signer on the key ring/key and roles/storage.objectCreator on attestation bucket.
tia: +1. Also add iam.conditions so the signer SA can only sign when the build tag matches `rebase-*/stable`.
nina: Example IAM binding we'd apply:

```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "rebase_signer" {
  crypto_key_id = var.rebase_key
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.signer"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:rebase-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

nina: And we'll have the runner call KMS to sign the image manifest and upload both image + manifest to GCR with provenance metadata.
build-bot: Build #4523 started for job=rebase-base-2026-03-24 on runner=rebase-runner
omar: For RBAC, also need to ensure humans can't trigger ad-hoc signs. Enforce via a CI gating step and a separate admin role for emergency signing.
tia: We should add an approval step: only members of group `image-release-admins` can bypass gating to sign non-tagged builds.
grant: For audit logs: I'll create a bucket `redwood-rebase-audit` and set retention 7y. Output path will be: gs://redwood-rebase-audit/cloudkms/.
nina: Action items: Nina - write KMS key policy and CI gating doc; Omar - add iam.conditions for signer SA; Grant - create audit bucket and retention; Tia - add `image-release-admins` long-lived group and document approval flow. Deadline: Mon EOD before rebase Tue.
tia: I'll create a short runbook for rollback in case a signed image shows vuln in post-scan. Keep it minimal.
nina: Perfect. If anyone spots policy conflicts with enterprise KMS HSM, ping me.
omar: Noted. I'll post the terraform diff once ready. :thumbsup:
build-bot: Build #4523 succeeded: signed manifest uploaded at gs://rebase-proofs/4523/manifest.sig
nina: Great — thanks team. Final sync tomorrow 10am.
